**My picks for iPhone 17**

**1. Best overall slim: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim), $54.99**
- It's 0.34" thick and 4.3 oz, with 15W Qi2 wireless charging. Anker's page says it's "Best for Your iPhone 17 Series" and lists iPhone 17 under 15W compatibility.
- 9to5Mac says it runs cooler than the competition and is the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery.
- Buy: https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank
- Anker's page also has a footnote saying it's compatible only with iPhone 12 through 16, which contradicts its own iPhone 17 claims. Confirm before buying.

**2. Best slim with more capacity: INIU SnapGo Air 10K (25W Qi2.2), about $43-49**
- It has 10,000mAh and 25W wireless charging, which iPhone 17 supports (Qi2.2 works on iPhone 16 and later). It also has 45W wired output and a built-in lanyard-style cable.
- It's about 0.5" thick and 195g. Macworld lists it as an equal-slimmest 10K MagSafe pack.
- Android Central listed it at $42.99 on Amazon and $44.99 at INIU. I only have the review page, not a direct product link: https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge

**3. Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K), about $53-70**
- It's 0.27" thick and 104g. Android Central calls it the thinnest and lightest it has tested.
- It only charges wirelessly at 7.5W, so it's slow for a top-up. It has a 22.5W wired output as a backup.
- Android Central listed it at $52.99 on Amazon, with a $69.99 list price. Retailer links are on the review page above.

**Other options**
- **ReelCharge ReelSafe (5K):** a 0.35" semi-solid-state pack with 15W wireless, $49.99. It's in the same Android Central review.
- **TORRAS MiniMag Pro (10K):** IP54 water and dust resistance, but thicker at 0.57" and 195g, at $69.99-79.99. It's in the same review.
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10K, Qi2.2, 45W):** $59.99, or $53.99 with code AM52. The code passed a cart test on 2026-10-25. I didn't find its thickness in the results, so I can't confirm it's slim. This is an affiliate link: https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w

**Which to choose**
- For the slimmest pack that still charges at a good speed, get the Anker Nano 5K.
- If you want about two charges and fast 25W wireless without much bulk, get the INIU SnapGo Air.
- A 5K pack gets you roughly 60-75% of a charge (Macworld). Wireless charging also needs a magnetic case, and thick cases like OtterBox Defender can break the connection (Anker).

Sources: Anker, Android Central, Macworld (https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html), 9to5Mac (https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/), Dealectric (https://dealectric.com/baseus-discount-codes).
